  <li><strong>Government legislative moves:</strong> The government is moving to introduce a bill to rename Kerala to &#x27;Keralam&#x27; in the Lok Sabha, even as the session faces criticism for the absence of other key legislative items.<span class="source-chips"><a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">W5</a> <a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">W7</a></span></li>
